role: CI gate: every regex in Tools/copy_linter/prohibited_terms.json user_facing_prohibited must be matched by some alternative from MedicalTermLexicon*.swift latin:/unbounded: arrays.
toplevel: cd to repo root. CONFIG missing -> 2; no lexicon file -> 2. Python: parse JSON (error -> 2); bracket-walk latin:/unbounded: arrays; unescape; latin wrapped in \b(?:...)\b; compile errors or empty-matching alternatives -> 2; fewer than 100 alternatives -> 2. For each user_facing_prohibited pattern probes_for() expands every spelling (each alternation branch, optional part present/absent, class member; * and {m,n} at minimum, \w as a placeholder word; lookarounds/\b dropped; >5000 spellings, unparsable or empty -> 2); a spelling not matching its own pattern -> 2; a spelling matched by no lexicon alternative -> missing -> exit 1. Else clean. coach_response_prohibited is still not checked. Red until MedicalTermLexicon covers the 8 spellings in the handoff.

flags.text: Header says none of the three lists may grow past the others, but only user_facing_prohibited -> lexicon is checked; coach_response_prohibited and lexicon -> build-time are not. A pattern whose synthesised probe is empty is skipped silently (`if not probe: continue`).
